newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka adjusted downward against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka adjusted downward against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh central bank said on Thursday that the taka has been adjusted downward against the U.S. dollar to 42.20/42.40 from 42.02/42.25 effective Saturday.

A central bank statement gave no reason for the adjustment just before the foreign exchange market closed for the Moslem Friday weekend. But officials with the commercial banks said the move had been made to boost the country's exports and to maintain parity with other regional currencies.
The last adjustment was on August 1 when the taka became cheaper by about 0.6 percent at 41.80/42.00 against the dollar.
